title: 宝塚記念の後に・それはあまりに眩しく

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Amid wild excitement, the curtain closes on the Takarazuka Kinen, where Air Groove has managed to snatch victory from Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Air Groove is dazzled by Suzuka's magnificent running, which sets her fans ablaze with unparallelled excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Worrying that she can't compare, Air Groove finds herself in fear of Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her heart bruised and her composure rattled, Air Groove puts on a brave face to focus on the Sapporo Kinen ahead, but nonetheless leaves the racecourse dejected.
